title: Nukes used to bring down UFOs

tellings.quote: And yeah, Tom says that uh they've used nukes to like bring down UFOs, right?

plain: The military has used nuclear weapons to bring UFOs down, according to the musician Tom DeLonge. The claim comes second-hand from a researcher who goes by the online name RedPandaKoala, who mentions it on the show as something DeLonge has said. If true, it would mean there have been armed clashes with these craft that the public never heard about.
